widgets.text: A side-scrolling brawler over the GT story. Health and ki are in the game's own HUD; the companion has no live data for this game yet.

Chain your basic attacks into combos, keep ki charged for blasts, and swap to a fresh fighter when one is low (the team is shared by the stage). Learn each fighter's special from the pause menu move list.
Bosses take far more hits than stage enemies: dodge their charge attacks by moving off their row, then punish with a full combo. Ranged ki blasts work best against bosses that fly.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Follows Dragon Ball GT: the Black Star Dragon Ball search, the Baby arc, Super 17 and the Shadow Dragons.
Enemies drop food and capsules that heal HP or refill ki; grab them before a boss door.
Finishing story chapters unlocks fighters for the other modes.
Chapters are linear; finish a chapter to save your progress.
